lumen-page-case-study — Case Studies

Case study · Water

Clearing a two-year connection backlog

National grid operator · 11 months · Asset strategy and process redesign

2 yrs

Backlog cleared

−63%

Time to connect

4,000

Sites in scope

The problem

Connection applications were queuing for two years. The queue was not a capacity problem — it was a sequencing problem nobody owned.

What we did

Rebuilt the assessment process around parallel rather than serial review, then sat with the team for four months while it bedded in.

Month 1

Diagnosis

Two weeks shadowing the assessment team rather than interviewing them.

Month 3

Redesign

New process agreed with the regulator before it was built.

Month 7

Pilot

One region, running both processes in parallel.

Month 11

Rollout

All regions, with the client's own team leading it.

They did not hand us a report. They handed us a working process and then left.

Iris Kovács

Head of connections

Similar problem?

Talk to the team that did it

Support

Questions we get most weeks

How quickly do you respond?

Weekdays, usually within the hour, always the same day. Out of hours goes to an on-call engineer for platform issues only.

Yes, and it updates automatically rather than when somebody remembers.

On multi-site and enterprise plans, yes. On single site you get whoever is on, which is a team of six.

Sunday 02:00–04:00 ICT, announced a week ahead. Most releases need no window at all.

lumen-page-legal — Legal

Last updated 1 August 2026

Privacy notice

What we collect, why, and how to make us stop.

What we collect

Contact details you give us, and standard server logs. No advertising trackers, no third-party analytics, no session recording.

Why we keep it

To answer you, to run the contract, and to meet our legal obligations. Nothing is used to build a profile of you.

Your rights

What you can ask us to do

Any of these, by email, and we act within thirty days without asking why.

  • Send you everything we hold
  • Correct anything wrong
  • Delete it
  • Stop processing it
  • Send it somewhere else in a readable format

Do you use cookies?

One, to keep you signed in. It is not used for anything else and there is no banner because there is nothing to consent to.

Where is data held?

Singapore and Frankfurt. Never transferred outside those without a mechanism you can inspect.

Who do you share it with?

Our hosting and email providers, both listed in the full notice. Nobody else.

Questions about any of this?

The data protection lead answers directly.

privacy@example.com
